Property-based testing in Kiro: 5 steps (find bugs unit tests miss)

Five steps to bug-hunt with property-based testing in Kiro.

1. Write EARS requirements - Properties start from your requirements.
2. Kiro extracts properties - It turns requirements into things that must always hold.
3. Hundreds of inputs - The tests throw hundreds of edge cases at your code.
4. Failures shrink - A failing case is shrunk to the smallest example.
5. Fix the bug - Rerun until every property passes. IDE only.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/correctness/

Which step surprised you? Comment its number. theAIgurukul posts a Kiro tip every day - subscribe.
